description: Use for 'here is my account list' or 'which companies am I tracking?'. List accounts in your connected Intakra workspace, or match supplied domains against that list. Returns missing domains, recorded check dates and pagination. This reads saved records and does not add accounts or run a new check.

domains.description: Optional company domains to check against your tracked list, up to 200. Omit to use your tracked accounts.

offset.description: Start at this offset, default 0. Follow next_offset for remaining accounts.

name: list_accounts
title: List tracked accounts
